title: Auna tashoshinku, duba shirye-shiryen, saita ƙa'idodin alamar ku

say: Auna tashoshi, duba cewa kun shirya, kuma saita ƙa'idodin alamar ku.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don ƙirar 1 na Faɗawa da Rarraba Alamar: Tashoshi, Shirye da Dokokin Samfura.
Sayar da kai tsaye akan WhatsApp, Instagram ko rumfa yana ba ku cikakken farashi, amma kowane siyarwa yana buƙatar lokacin ku.

say: Kafin ka ƙara sabon abu, auna abin da kake da shi. Amaka tana sayar da tulunta kai tsaye akan naira 4,000. A watan da ya gabata ta sayar da kwalba 400.
Gilashin 260 sun shiga WhatsApp da Instagram. Naira 1,040,000 kenan.
An sayar da kwalba 100 a rumfarta ta kasuwar ranar Asabar, kan Naira 400,000.
Kuma Salon daya ya sayi kwalba 40 akan farashin ciniki Naira 2,800. Naira 112,000 kenan.
Jimlar ta naira miliyan 1,552,000. WhatsApp da Instagram sun kawo 67.0% na sa. Don haka kashi biyu cikin uku na kudin da take samu ya dogara ne akan wayarta da asusunta na sada zumunta.
Idan aka yi hacking din wannan account, yawancin watanta ya tafi. Ɗauki lambobinku daga littafin tallace-tallace ko bayanan banki, ba daga ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya ba.
Yawancin sabbin tallace-tallacen kantuna sun gaza saboda mai siyarwar bai shirya ba. Yi maki 0, 1 ko 2 akan yankuna biyar.

Marufi da takarda: lakabin, CAC, NAFDAC inda ake buƙata
Capacity: ƙarin raka'a ba tare da masu siye da yunwa ba
Babban ɗakin farashi: ribar da ta bar bayan iyakar su
Cash da admin: hannun jari, daftari, adana bayanan oda

say: Daya. Kowane tsari yana kama, ƙamshi kuma yana yin iri ɗaya.

say: Sarkar kantin magani mai rassa 4 tana tambayar Amaka kwalba 24 kowane reshe kowane mako biyu. Wato kwalba 192 a wata.

panel.heading: Shin Amaka na iya ba da sarkar kantin magani?
items: Sarkar tambaya: 4 rassan x 24 kwalba x 2 = 192 kwalba
Sabbin jimlar 592, amma iyakarta shine 500
Kuɗin da aka ɗaure: 192 x 1,900 = 364,800 naira
Fara da rassa 2: kwalba 96, kimanin naira 182,400

say: A hada da kwalba 400 na yanzu tana bukatar 592. Amma kicin dinta da mataimakanta guda biyu zasu iya mikewa zuwa 500. Za ta zama gajere 92 kwalba kowane wata.

say: Na farko, saita farashin siyarwar da aka ba da shawarar, don haka abokin ciniki yana ganin kusan farashi ɗaya a ko'ina.

panel.heading: Dokokin farashi guda uku waɗanda ke kare ku

cards.t: Kasuwancin da aka ba da shawarar
cards.d: Ba da shawarar farashin shiryayye guda ɗaya, RRP, don haka abokin ciniki yana ganin kusan farashi ɗaya a duk inda take siyayya.
Farashin ciniki mafi ƙanƙanta, daga farashi. Kudin Naira 1,900, kashi 25%: 1,900/0.75 = kusan 2,533.
Kada ku siyar da kan layi mai nisa ƙasa da farashin kanti. Siyayya a 4,000, ku a 3,200: shagon ya daina yin oda.

say: Na biyu, saita farashin bene daga farashin ku, ba daga matsin mai siye ba. Idan tulun ya kai Naira 1,900 kuma kana bukatar kaso 25%, kasa ta kai Naira 2,533.

say: Siyan kai tsaye yana nufin shagon ya sayi haja kuma ya mallake ta. Raka'a da ba a siyar ba shine matsalarsa, sai dai idan kun yarda akasin haka.

say: Bayarwa yana nufin har yanzu kuna da haja, kuma shagon yana biyan abin da ake siyarwa bayan kowace ƙidaya.
Shiga ciki ya fi sauƙi, amma ya fi ku haɗari, don haka rubuta wanda ya biya raka'a da suka lalace ko suka ɓace.

say: Idan ba a rubuta kalma ba, kowane bangare yana tunawa da shi daban. Yarjejeniyar mai shafi daya ta Amaka ta ce dole ne a sanar da barnar a cikin sa'o'i 48.
Lokacin da tulun ya fashe, wannan ka'idar ta daidaita shi a cikin saƙo ɗaya maimakon jayayya.

Oda mafi ƙaranci da bayarwa
Sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi da hanyar
Kai tsaye ko kayan jigilar kaya
Komawa, lalacewa da ƙarewa
Bitar kwanan wata da ƙarewa

say: Don tunawa. Auna tashoshi daga ainihin rikodin. Yi maki shirye-shiryen ku, kuma bincika iya aiki da tsabar kuɗi kafin ku ce e. Saita farashin ku daga farashi kuma ku kiyaye daidaito. Kuma sanya kowace yarjejeniya a rubuce, tare da yanke shawarar hanyar tafiya kafin ku yi shawarwari.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Auna rabon kowane tasha kafin ƙara sabo
Maki shirye-shiryen kafin ku yi tsalle; 8 zuwa 10 yana nufin tafi
Yi lissafin iya aiki da sharuɗɗan kiredit tsabar kuɗi
Saita RRP, farashin bene daga farashi, da kiyaye daidaito
Yarda da sharuddan rubuce-rubuce kuma ku san wurin tafiyar ku

say: Yanzu gina tushen tashar ku, ƙididdige shirye-shiryenku, rubuta takardar ma'aunin alamar ku, da tsara yarjejeniyar ku ta farko.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Aikin ku na wannan module
items: Gina teburin tushen tashar ku
Kammala katin makin shirin ku
Rubuta takardar ma'aunin alamar ku
Zana yarjejeniya mai shafi ɗaya
